channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Jakob Poeltl | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Jakob Poeltl from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Darko Rajakovic on Jakob Poeltl
item.description:
Darko Rajakovic on Jakob Poeltl:

“He needs to be part of the solution for us. He needs to be more aggressive. He needs to dominate the glass... He's going to be a big part of Game 3 and I believe he's going to perform really well.”

Darko Rajakovic on Jakob Poeltl, Apr 22, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Immanuel Quickley on Jakob Poeltl
item.description:
Quickley on Poeltl:

“I’ve gotta give a shoutout to Jakob. He’s one of the best screen setters I’ve played with and is such an unselfish player…He does so much stuff for us that doesn’t show up in the stat sheet. You’ve gotta give him a lot of credit. We appreciate him a lot.”

Immanuel Quickley on Jakob Poeltl, Dec 2, 2025. Source: x.com.

item.title: Masai Ujiri on Tracy McGrady, DeMar DeRozan, Jakob Poeltl
item.description:
Libaan Osman:Masai Ujiri on the Toronto Raptors getting the 9th pick in the 2025 NBA Draft:

“Tracy McGrady. DeMar DeRozan. Jakob Poeltl. We’ll be fine. I guarantee you we’ll be fine.”

Masai Ujiri on Tracy McGrady, DeMar DeRozan, Jakob Poeltl, May 12, 2025. Source: Twitter.

item.title: Masai Ujiri on Jakob Poeltl
item.description:
Masai Ujiri on the Jakob Poeltl trade:

“When you trade a 1st-round pick for a starting center in the NBA, in our business & for us, it's good - for now & for the future.”

Masai Ujiri on Jakob Poeltl, Jan 18, 2024. Source: Twitter @JLew1050.

item.title: Masai Ujiri on Jakob Poeltl
item.description:
Michael Grange:Masai Ujiri on acquiring Jakob Poeltl:

“I think it's something we've lacked on this team [a big]... I haven't done my part, maybe, for this team to maybe play a little bit better.”

Masai Ujiri on Jakob Poeltl, Feb 9, 2023. Source: Twitter @michaelgrange.

item.title: Tre Jones on Jakob Poeltl
item.description:
Tom Orsborn:Tre Jones on how easy it is to play with birthday boy Jakob Poeltl:

“He understands the game. Whatever coverage we are in defensively, it’s easy to be on the same page with him. Offensively, he makes really good reads. He’s really smart. He reads the defense really well.”

Tre Jones on Jakob Poeltl, Oct 15, 2022. Source: Twitter @tom_orsborn.

item.title: Gregg Popovich on Jakob Poeltl
item.description:
Tom Orsborn:Pop on Poeltl:

“What’s most amazing about him is his consistency. He’s a real pro. He comes every night and gives what he should give, what he can give, and it’s consistent. That’s the best part of him.”

Gregg Popovich on Jakob Poeltl, May 12, 2021. Source: Twitter @tom_orsborn.

item.title: Gregg Popovich on Jakob Poeltl
item.description:
Josh Lewenberg:Pop on Poeltl:

“His general makeup, attitude, demeanour, work ethic would be a gift for any coach & any team. He's always a great teammate,he plays his role, he competes in every way shape & form every single game... He's a lot of fun to be around. He's a wonderful human being”

Gregg Popovich on Jakob Poeltl, Apr 14, 2021. Source: Twitter @JLew1050.

item.title: Gregg Popovich on Jakob Poeltl
item.description:
Tom Orsborn:Pop on Jakob Poeltl and how he's getting used to playing with the younger guys and vice versa:

“We have to let them know once in a while, it’s legal to throw him the ball. It makes him feel a little bit better, I think.”

Gregg Popovich on Jakob Poeltl, Mar 14, 2021. Source: Twitter @tom_orsborn.

item.title: Pau Gasol on Jakob Poeltl
item.description:
Gasol on trying to fit in with young Jakob Poeltl playing so well:

“I will fit as well as I can with the opportunities and the minutes that I will be given. I don’t take anything for granted. I will go out there and do what I do and be the type of player I am.”

Pau Gasol on Jakob Poeltl, Dec 28, 2018. Source: Twitter @tom_orsborn.
